entry_points.text: Interval lookup asserts shared protection and queries the ordered tree with an inclusive end in both memory models; acquisition falls back to the gate area through a dedicated service; huge split locates the middle directory and no-ops when absent.

exports.text: Slow acquisition for current, unlocked, and remote contexts with optional faulting. Empty ranges return zero; starts are normalized; storage present installs managed refs with cache care else only presence is ensured; partial progress outranks later errors; dump converts non-unitary results to null.

Single-address fault, prepopulation, and probes. Fault needs read or write rights plus platform approval; populate skips lock-on-fault and device maps, fails inaccessible, writes only private writable else forced touch; probes step pages returning tail, safe form faulting under shared protection.

Fast and pin wrappers validate then use common fallback. Fast-only forbids slow path; general fast merges fast and slow counts preserving partial pins; pin variants add pin and touch for current, remote, or unlocked callers; fast fails to zero on unsupported ranges, concurrent fork protection, or bad flags.

Long-term, memfd, and copy services. Scan counts unpinnable folios, isolates ordinary after drain and huge under global lock with interrupts disabled; migration targets any node, converting coherent pins then moving with retry and restore on failure; memfd pins shared and huge files only with range checks, huge-shift indexing, alloc on miss, fault mutex only around cache add, and full retry on movable; copy duplicates subpages allowing schedule; pin add needs dma-pinned state.

Device migration completion over frame arrays. Outward call delegates with absent context; finalize resolves owners, discards unusable destinations, picks survivor ensuring reclaim visibility, replaces entries, and releases locks and refs while keeping the fault owner locked.

Huge reservation control. Reserve skips no-reserve areas, uses inode map for shared or fresh map for private, charges before commit with race adjust and unwind; unreserve under inode lock tolerates missing maps; dequeue holds huge lock with interrupts disabled while reservation remains.

hazards.text: Mismatch during mapping or split returns retryable busy without partial transfer; array allocation failure aborts split; writeback, missing context, tail private, mapped, unlocked, non-large, non-anon, unpinned adds, and bad attaches trigger bug or warn.

Granularity and status. Bounds page aligned with page steps coalescing extents; empty zero, acquisitions counts, probes tail bytes, dump page or null, device zero or busy, long-term retry; failures negative errno; tests use benchmark selectors with dump limit, clamped one-based selection, and a context holding mutex, array, and count.

invariants.text: Validation and eligibility. Reserved flags rejected; pin and get exclusive; durable pins need extra rules and arrays; anon preparation idempotent; fast allows anon, shared, and huge, denies durable writable other files, secret, and slab, treating missing maps conservatively; routed check allows interval.

Lockless fast walk goes top to leaf, abandoning on absent, special, protection-none, permission, acquisition, modification, ineligible folio, sharing, or inaccessible content; otherwise it records pages, marks referenced, and derives leaf coverage from span.
Disabled builds are neutral successes doing no work for remote acquisition, movable migration, huge device insertion, fast ranges, and compound split.

Device unmap, check, migrate, insert. Unmap drains, scans marking compound, isolates once, validates exclusivity, restores failures; check bounds extra refs to collector, fault, zone, address-space, and private allowances; mapping needs observed equal expectation plus extra plus one else retry; inner clears migrate on absent dest or error, opens one range, splits oversized compound or drops on mismatch, needs anon without swap cache for private or coherent, rejects other zone devices, migrates per subpage; insert needs anon area, stable space, empty target, splitting huge zero and charging first, small holding leaf lock and huge holding middle lock; span one unless compound.

Huge split. Needs unmapped locked large anon with refs within expectation plus one, interrupts off to order zero; freezes to cache count plus one, detaches queue, adjusts stats, splits, unfreezes tails first; successors get device callback, reclaim join, swap replace, cache store in range else drop; cache baseline zero for anon outside swap else page count; order walk descends skipping order one for anon, duplicates memcg, clones flags, mapping, index, swap, and cpu hints, rescans poison, records order or uncompounds; poison if any subpage poisoned; order setter rejects zero, non-large, oversized; helper holds extra ref and replicates entries preserving low bits.

Middle-directory resolve descends global, fourth, upper, then middle levels, returning null unless each upper level present; address-directed split no-ops when absent, otherwise splits with the given freeze choice.

locks.text: Shared protection asserted, acquired killably when unlocked else normally, released on exit; retry may drop and reacquire tracked by visible flag, reacquiring on completion or retry.
Fast disables interrupts around table walk blocking reclaim and sync, samples fork sequence for pins rechecking after and failing on change, declaring read-lock dependency when slow allowed.

Sharable huge areas use one refcounted lock with semaphore and back pointer in private data, released under write; maps carry refcount, spinlock, region list and cache, semaphore, progress, and cgroup info cleared for shared and set for private.

Device and split locking. Unmap holds folio locks, unlocking restored except fault folio and balancing refs; split needs caller lock, guards deferred queue, freezes before list, swap, and reclaim changes with interrupts off; reclaim lock required to queue successors.

state_machines.text: Fault and fallback. Completed or retry reacquires protection, marks ownership, returns or loops with tried set; outer resumes at faulting offset, checks signals, continues until stable; fallback validates, tries fast, handles slow remainder and merges counts.

Device entries start requested, clear on absent dest, validation, mapping, unsupported target, or split failure; compound marks spans clearing after split; empty reasserts before insert; finalize resolves owners, discards unusable, chooses survivors, releases.

structs.text: Durable-pin container holds a union of page or folio arrays seen as entries with a discriminant and length; helpers fetch the owning folio, clear entries after transfer, drain all by mode, and skip entries covered by the current large extent to reach the next folio.

Frame arrays encode numbers with low-bit migrate and compound flags plus shift; span one unless compound, when middle-directory count applies; order bounded by maximum; addresses use page shift, mask, untagged, huge shift, and task-size limit; context carries start, end, area, source, fault page, and owner.
